title: How Binance Replaced $6.3 Billion In 48 Hours! 🤯
alt_hooks: Did you know Binance replaced a $6.3 billion hack in just forty-eight hours?
How did Binance instantly recover from the biggest crypto heist in history?
Six point three billion dollars vanished from Binance in seconds.
